name: format_text_into_output
description: Scans a format string, passing literal characters to an output function and expanding each percent specifier. Specifiers cover characters, strings, decimal, octal, unsigned and hexadecimal values, with width, precision and flags. It returns the number of characters written, or -1 when output fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A3A
name: perform_signed_division
description: Divides the signed first input by the second through a further routine, negating the quotient when the operand signs differ. It returns the adjusted result together with the second input's value in a 64-bit value.

name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls one routine and returns a 64-bit value formed from the D1 result of that call and the original D1 contents.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one further routine and returns, with no other operations.

name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor in the data registers and returns the quotient and remainder together in a 64-bit value. It uses a bit-shifting loop for large divisors and 16-bit divide steps otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0AE2
name: forward_with_base_address
description: Passes its argument together with an address computed from the base register to another routine, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0AF8
name: emit_char_with_newline_check
description: Forwards a character and its stream to another routine. When the character is a newline and a flag bit in the stream is set, it also makes a follow-up call with minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B3C
name: return_without_work
description: Library code that consists only of a return, so it does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B3E
name: store_char_or_overflow
description: Stores a character in a buffer when the write position is below the end, then advances the position. When the buffer is full it passes the character to a further routine and returns that result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B6A
name: write_byte_field_to_buffer
description: Writes the byte at offset 11 of a structure to the buffer at the current write pointer, advances that pointer, and returns the byte value.

name: iterate_memory_range
description: Walks a fixed memory range in steps of 22 bytes and calls a further routine for each step address.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0BA8
name: release_structure_fields
description: Releases a structure: when the pointer is null it returns minus one. Otherwise it calls further routines for the flagged fields, combines their results, clears the structure's fields, and returns the combined result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0BC4
name: release_structure_fields
description: Releases the optional resources of a structure when its flag byte is set, combining the routine results. It then clears the structure's fields and returns the combined result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C2E
name: write_byte_to_buffered_stream
description: Writes one byte to a buffered stream. A write of minus one resets the buffer and returns zero, while an error state returns minus one. Otherwise the byte is stored in the buffer, or passed to a further routine when the buffer cannot take it, and returned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C54
name: put_buffered_byte_from_argument
description: Writes the byte held in the caller's argument block to a buffered stream, resetting the buffer when the argument is minus one. It returns the byte on success and minus one on error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C90
name: put_buffered_byte_from_argument
description: Writes the byte held in the caller's argument block to a buffered stream, resetting the buffer when the argument is minus one. It returns the byte on success and minus one on error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0CAA
name: put_buffered_byte_from_argument
description: Writes the byte held in the caller's argument block to a buffered stream, sending it through a further routine when the buffer size is one. It returns the stored value on success and minus one on error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0CF0
name: store_argument_byte_in_buffer
description: Stores the byte from the caller's argument block at the current write pointer of a buffer, advances the pointer, and returns that byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D20
name: allocate_free_record_slot
description: Searches a table of 22-byte records in the base area for an unused record, clears its three fields, and returns it. It returns null when every record is in use.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D48
name: find_free_record_from
description: Starts at the given record and scans forward in steps of 22 bytes for a record whose flag byte is zero. It clears that record's three words and returns it, or null when none is free.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D4A
name: clear_record_words
description: Clears the three 32-bit words at the record pointer and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D58
name: init_record_with_buffer
description: Allocates a 1024-byte buffer through the allocation further routine. On success it stores the buffer in the record and sets a flag bit, then calls a further routine on the record's byte field and sets a further flag when that succeeds. On failure it uses a one-byte size and points the buffer at the record itself.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D8A
name: init_record_with_static_buffer
description: Sets a record's size to 1024 and its buffer pointer to a static area, sets a flag bit, and calls a further routine with the record's byte field, marking an extra flag when that call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DB8
name: free_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of nodes from the head pointer in the base area, releasing each node through a further routine with its size plus eight bytes. It then clears the head and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DC6
name: free_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of nodes from the given pointer, releasing each node through a further routine with its size plus eight bytes. It then clears the list head in the base area and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DEA
name: allocate_list_node_with_head
description: Allocates a node sized to the argument plus eight bytes through a further routine, links it at the head of the list held in the base area, and returns the node's data address. It returns null when allocation fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E16
name: push_list_node_without_alloc
description: Links an existing node at the head of the list in the base area, storing the previous head and a size field, and returns the node's data address.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E2A
name: forward_argument_to_routine
description: Passes its argument directly to another routine and returns, with no other operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E3A
name: unlink_and_free_list_node
description: Searches the list in the base area for the node whose data address matches the argument. When it is found the node is unlinked and released through a further routine with its size plus eight bytes, and zero is returned. It returns minus one when no node matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E4A
name: unlink_and_free_list_node
description: Walks a list from a given node looking for the node whose data address matches the argument. When it is found the node is unlinked and released through a further routine, and zero is returned. It returns minus one when no node matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E66
name: unlink_list_node_and_release
description: Unlinks a node from the list, using its previous link or the list head, then releases the node through a further routine and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E6E
name: pop_list_head_node
description: Sets the list head to the next pointer of the given node, calls a further routine, and returns zero.
